items.text: Work within a cross-functional team of robotics scientists and engineers to develop next- generation autonomous mobile robots (AMR)
Design system architecture, design and write software for robotic systems, sub-systems or modules in a continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) environment
AMR setup, integration, programming and testing using different brands of mobile robots and mobile manipulators, including proprietary robots
Providing hands-on on-site support for software development, integration, testing and troubleshooting of AMR platforms
Translate new technology and research outputs into modular and re-useable software packages
Design of experiments to benchmark system performance by adopting in-house and/or industrial test methodology
Adopting latest standards and/or methodology to work (Agile, standards, open source, common platform)

items: 英文：精通、精通、精通、精通
key_values.label: 語文條件
key_values.text: 英文：精通、精通、精通、精通

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
• Degree/Master’s in Electronics, Computing, Mechatronics Engineering or equivalent.
• 4–6 years of relevant experience in robotics software design, development, and system integration.
• Strong passion for robotic navigation, sensing and perception, control system design, prototyping, and practical problem-solving, with hands-on experience working directly with robotics hardware and integrated robotic systems.
• Proficient in programming using Python and C++, with solid experience developing and deploying software in a Linux environment.
• Proficient in Robot Operating System (ROS/ROS2), including robot software development, deployment, debugging, system integration, and overall lifecycle management of robotics applications.
• Solid background in robotic perception, with hands-on experience deploying perception models on AI edge devices using TensorRT, YOLOv models, segmentation techniques, and advanced AI frameworks.
• Experienced in software development practices within an AGILE and collaborative engineering environment, making effective use of CI/CD tools, breaking down complex robotic software tasks, participating in code reviews, and contributing to high-quality team workflows.
• Result-oriented, independent, proactive, and a strong team player with excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
• Strong in written and verbal communication in English
